name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Denominator Datasets
description: Medicaid MAX-TAF denominator datasets contain harmonized Medicaid Analytic eXtract (MAX) and T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF) enrollment products, including a beneficiary-year denominator and county/ZCTA aggregate products.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Denominator V1 Datasets
description: Harmonized Medicaid MAX-TAF denominator covering all states from 2000-2018: a beneficiary-state-year file of Medicaid/CHIP enrollees with demographics, residence geography (ZCTA, county, state), and monthly eligibility, CHIP, managed care, fee-for-service, disability and Medicare dual status, plus county/ZCTA yearly and daily aggregate counts, denominator covariates (rates and percentages), and stratified counts. State coverage varies during the 2014-2015 MAX-to-TAF transition.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: Medicaid MAX-TAF Denominator File
description: Beneficiary-year Medicaid/CHIP denominator: one row per enrollee, state and year for everyone with a MAX (1999-2015) or TAF (2014+) enrollment record, with demographics, residence geography (ZCTA, county, state), and monthly (January-December) eligibility, scope of benefits, enrollment days, CHIP, managed care, fee-for-service and Medicare dual status.

content.bene_id: String: CCW beneficiary ID, the same ID used in Medicare data. Use it to link people across years and across MAX and TAF. Source: BENE_ID.
content.msis_id: String: State-assigned MSIS identification number. Raw in MAX; a 32-character encrypted hash in TAF, so MAX and TAF values can't be matched; use bene_id for linkage. Source: MSIS_ID.
content.year: Int32: Calendar year of the enrollment file (from the source file path).
content.dob: Date: Date of birth. Source: EL_DOB (MAX 2005+) / none (MAX 1999-2004) / BIRTH_DT (TAF).
content.age_dob: Int64: Age as defined in the Medicare denominator: year - yob (data year minus birth year). 0-115, or NULL if dob is unknown.
content.sex: String: Sex, recoded to Medicare's numeric SEX_IDENT_CD convention. 0 = unknown (U), 1 = male (M), 2 = female (F), NULL = missing/unrecognized. Source: EL_SEX_CD / SEX / SEX_CD.
content.race: String: Harmonized race/ethnicity code; 0-6 align with Medicare's research race variable (~race_rti), 7-8 are Medicaid extensions. 0 = unknown, 1 = white non-Hispanic, 2 = black non-Hispanic, 3 = other (non-Hispanic or unknown ethnicity), 4 = Asian non-Hispanic, 5 = Hispanic (any race), 6 = American Indian/Alaska Native, 7 = Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander, 8 = multiracial (non-Hispanic or unknown ethnicity), NULL = missing. For a Medicare-comparable grouping, combine 4 and 7. Source: EL_RACE_ETHNCY_CD / RACE / RACE_ETHNCTY_CD.
content.ethnicity: String: Harmonized Hispanic/Latino ethnicity code. 0 = not Hispanic or Latino, 1 = Mexican/Mexican American/Chicano, 2 = Puerto Rican, 3 = Cuban, 4 = another Hispanic/Latino/Spanish origin, 5 = Hispanic or Latino (subcategory unknown), 9 = unknown, NULL = missing. MAX only distinguishes 0, 5 and 9; not collected in MAX before 2005 (NULL for people seen only in 1999-2004). Source: ETHNICITY_CODE / none / ETHNCTY_CD.
content.dod: Date: Date of death (state-reported MSIS/T-MSIS; CMS notes deaths may be underreported, so less complete than Medicare's). Capped at December 31 of the 115th birth year when the reported death date implies an age over 115, or when no death is reported but the person is still seen enrolled at or after age 115 (in any year's enrollment file). Source: EL_DOD / none / DEATH_DT.
content.yod: Int64: Year of death, YEAR(dod) of the capped dod.
content.zcta: String: 5-digit ZIP Code Tabulation Area of residence, from the residence ZIP (most recent in the year) via the UDS ZIP-to-ZCTA crosswalk. Source: EL_RSDNC_ZIP_CD_LTST / ZIP / BENE_ZIP_CD.
content.county: String: 5-digit county FIPS code of residence (2-digit state + 3-digit county). Built from the enrollment record's state and county, then checked against the Census ZCTA-to-county crosswalk for that year; if that county isn't one of the ZCTA's counties, it's replaced with the ZCTA's most populous county. Medicare's county is an SSA code; crosswalk before comparing. Source: EL_RSDNC_CNTY_CD_LTST / FIPSCNTY / BENE_CNTY_CD, plus state FIPS.
content.state: String: 2-letter USPS abbreviation of the state of residence, from the county/ZCTA crosswalk. Not the state that submitted the record (which can differ, e.g. for out-of-state placements). Territories and Puerto Rico are kept.
content.n_states: Int64: Number of states the person has an enrollment record in this year (before geography exclusions). 2+ means the person has one row per state; count people with COUNT(DISTINCT bene_id).
content.missing_eligibility: String: Whether the person's eligibility information is missing for the year. 0 = not missing (MAX blank, TAF 0), 1 = missing (MAX 1 or 2, TAF 1), NULL = missing/unrecognized. Source: MSNG_ELG_DATA / MISSELIG / MISG_ELGBLTY_DATA_IND.
content.eligibility_ind: List[Int32]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) enrollment indicator. 1 = eligible this month, 0 = not eligible (blank code, 00, or MAX 99 = eligibility unknown). Scope differs by source: MAX = Medicaid only (incl. Medicaid-expansion CHIP), so a separate-CHIP-only month is 0 in MAX; TAF = Medicaid or any CHIP. For a definition consistent across MAX and TAF, use chip_type. Source: MAX_ELG_CD_MO_1-12 / none / ELGBLTY_GRP_CD_01-12.
content.eligibility_group: List[String]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) eligibility pathway, at full detail. MAX coding (1999-2013, and 2014-15 months without a T-MSIS value) combines maintenance-assistance status with basis of eligibility (e.g. aged_cash_or_ssi, disabled_medically_needy, low_income_child, child_section_1115, unknown); T-MSIS coding (TAF, and MAX 2014-15 via TMSIS_ELG_GRP_MO) uses T-MSIS groups (e.g. aged_or_disabled_cash_or_ssi, parent_caretaker, adult_expansion, pregnant, deemed_newborn, chip_child, medicare_savings_program, limited_or_other). not_eligible = not eligible this month. Category names change in 2014; compare across the change with broad groupings. Source: MAX_ELG_CD_MO_1-12 (+ TMSIS_ELG_GRP_MO_1-12, 2014-15) / none / ELGBLTY_GRP_CD_01-12.
content.disability_ind: List[Int32]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) disability-related eligibility (a Medicaid eligibility pathway, not Medicare disability entitlement). 0 = not disabled (not eligible, or eligible for a non-disability reason), 1 = eligible through a blind/disabled pathway, 2 = aged or disabled (TAF only; the T-MSIS code doesn't distinguish), NULL = missing or MAX 99 (eligibility unknown). Derived from the same source as eligibility_group.
content.restricted_benefits: List[String]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) scope of Medicaid/CHIP benefits (restricted benefits code); raw code kept. 0 = not eligible for Medicaid or CHIP, 1 = full scope of benefits, 2 = restricted: immigration status (typically emergency services only), 3 = restricted: Medicare cost-sharing only (QMB-only, SLMB-only, QI, QDWI), 4 = restricted: pregnancy-related services, 5 = restricted: other reasons (e.g. substance use, medically needy), 6 = family planning services only, 7 = alternative benchmark-equivalent benefit package, A = Psychiatric Residential Treatment Facility demonstration, B = Health Opportunity Account, C = separate CHIP dental-only coverage, D = Money Follows the Person demonstration (MAX code 8, recoded to D), 9 = benefit restrictions unknown (MAX only), W = premium payment assistance only, MA/NJ/OK/VT (MAX only), X = prescription drugs only (MAX only, 2003+), Y = prescription drugs plus Medicare cost-sharing only (MAX only, 2003+), Z = prescription drugs only, Medicare enrollee (MAX only, 2003+), E = restricted: other reasons, not minimum essential coverage (TAF only), F = COVID-19 testing only, 2020 public health emergency (TAF only), G = Medicare Part B ESRD benefit only (TAF only), NULL = missing/unrecognized. Codes 7, 8/D, A, B, C and W first appear in the later MAX years. Restricted-benefit enrollees are in the denominator, but most of their care won't appear in Medicaid claims. Source: EL_RSTRCT_BNFT_FLG_1-12 / RSTDBN1-12 / RSTRCTD_BNFTS_CD_01-12.
content.chip_ind: List[Int32]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) CHIP enrollment indicator (Medicaid-expansion or separate CHIP). 1 = chip_type 2, 3 or 4; 0 = chip_type 0 or 1; NULL = chip_type 9 (unknown) or missing. For separate CHIP only, use chip_type 3 or 4.
content.chip_type: List[String]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) CHIP/Medicaid enrollment code; the one enrollment signal defined the same way in MAX and TAF. 0 = not enrolled in Medicaid or CHIP, 1 = Medicaid not CHIP, 2 = Medicaid or Medicaid-expansion CHIP, 3 = separate CHIP, 4 = Medicaid and separate CHIP (TAF only), 9 = CHIP status unknown (MAX only), NULL = missing. Medicaid = 1, 2, 4; separate CHIP = 3, 4; either = 1-4. MAX reporting of separate CHIP was optional and incomplete, so separate-CHIP counts rise at the MAX-to-TAF changeover. Source: EL_CHIP_FLAG_1-12 / SCHIP1-12 / CHIP_CD_01-12.
content.medicaid_enrollment_days: List[Int32]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) days enrolled in Medicaid, including Medicaid-expansion CHIP (same scope in MAX and TAF). 0 to the number of days in the month; values outside that range are NULL. MAX sets it to 0 for people with claims but no eligibility record; the 1999-2004 field may be absent from the enclave files. For total Medicaid-or-CHIP days, add chip_enrollment_days and cap at the month's length. Source: EL_DAYS_EL_CNT_1-12 / none / MDCD_ENRLMT_DAYS_01-12.
content.chip_enrollment_days: List[Int32]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) days enrolled in separate CHIP. TAF only; NULL for every MAX year (MAX has no separate-CHIP enrollment days). 0 to the number of days in the month; values outside that range are NULL. Source: none / none / CHIP_ENRLMT_DAYS_01-12.
content.ffs_ind: List[Int32]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) fee-for-service indicator, derived from mc_plan_type and chip_type. 1 = enrolled and paid FFS (mc_plan_type ffs, pccm, dental, behavioral_health, aco or health_home); 0 = enrolled in a plan that pays for medical care (comprehensive, integrated_care_for_duals or other_managed_care); NULL = not enrolled in Medicaid/CHIP that month (chip_type not 1-4), or plan type other_combination / not_eligible / unknown / missing.
content.mc_plan_type: List[String]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) managed care plan type: the highest-priority plan that month, using TAF's plan-type hierarchy applied to MAX's plan combinations. comprehensive (MCO/HIO), other_managed_care (medical-only PIHP/PAHP, LTC/LTSS PIHP, PACE, transportation, pharmacy, disease management, other), dental, behavioral_health, pccm, aco (TAF only), health_home (TAF only), integrated_care_for_duals (TAF only), other_combination (MAX only), ffs (no managed care plan), not_eligible (MAX only), unknown (MAX only), NULL = missing. Source: MC_COMBO_MO_1-12 / MCCOMB01-12 / MC_PLAN_TYPE_CD_01-12.
content.dual_ind: List[Int32]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) Medicare-Medicaid dual eligibility indicator, derived from dual_code. 1 = dual_code 01-06, 08 or 11; 0 = dual_code 00, 09 or 10; NULL = dual_code 99 or missing. 09 (entitled to Medicare without Medicaid coverage) counts as not dual, which is stricter than Medicare's MBSF. For 'dual in any month', use dual_ind where monthly data exist (MAX 2006+ and TAF).
content.dual_code: List[String]: Monthly (Jan-Dec) harmonized Medicare dual eligibility code. 00 = eligible, not a Medicare beneficiary; 01 = QMB only; 02 = QMB and full Medicaid; 03 = SLMB only; 04 = SLMB and full Medicaid; 05 = QDWI; 06 = qualifying individual; 08 = other dual eligible; 09 = entitled to Medicare but without Medicaid coverage (TAF only); 10 = separate CHIP eligible and entitled to Medicare (Medicaid-only extension); 11 = dual, category unknown (MAX only; MAX's own code 09, moved to 11 so 09 has one meaning); 99 = unknown (MAX only); NULL = missing. Codes 00-09 and 99 match CCW MBSF DUAL_STUS_CD; 10 and 11 are Medicaid-only extensions. Not available for MAX 1999-2004; all 99 in MAX 2005. Source: EL_MDCR_DUAL_MO_1-12 (2007+), EL_MDCR_XOVR_MO_1-12 (2005-06) / none / DUAL_ELGBL_CD_01-12.
content.dual: String: Annual Medicare dual eligibility code (same codebook as dual_code): MAX's annual code, or TAF's latest code in the year (so someone who stopped being dual before December can show 00). The only dual information for MAX 1999-2005. Unlike Medicare's dual, a code, not a 0/1 flag. Source: EL_MDCR_DUAL_ANN (2007+), EL_MDCR_ANN_XOVR_99 (2005-06) / XOVER_N / DUAL_ELGBL_CD_LTST.

content.Row definition: One row per enrollee, state and year (key: bene_id + state + year). A person enrolled in two states in the same year has one row per state; count people with COUNT(DISTINCT bene_id), not COUNT(*). Every enrollment record is kept regardless of months enrolled; use the monthly columns (e.g. eligibility_ind, chip_type) to restrict to enrolled months.
content.Exclusions: In pipeline order: enrollment records with no beneficiary record; years after the (capped) year of death; known age_dob outside 0-115 (unknown birth date kept); missing or zero residence ZIP; ZIPs not in the ZIP-to-ZCTA crosswalk; no state FIPS match after the county/state crosswalk (territories and Puerto Rico kept). Counts per step are in the funnel of denom_stats_yyyy.json.
content.Monthly columns: 12-element lists, January to December. A month with no eligibility record is a NULL element; the whole list is NULL if every month is NULL.
content.Sources: Raw source fields are listed as MAX 2005+ / MAX 1999-2004 / TAF. Built from the MAX (1999-2015) and TAF (2014+) Person Summary / Demographic & Eligibility files, harmonized by harmonization-cms (ps.yaml), normalized by normalization-cms, and cleaned by cleaning-cms (duplicate MAX/TAF records for the same key resolved to the most common value, ties to the unknown code or NULL; dob ties take the earliest date, dod ties the latest; dod before dob set to NULL).
content.MAX to TAF changeover: States moved from MAX to TAF in 2014, 2015 or 2016; 2014-2015 contain both file types depending on the state, and some states have no data in either for 2015. Expect level shifts at each state's changeover, especially in separate CHIP (chip_type 3/4) and eligibility_ind.
content.Comparability with Medicare: state is residence (not the submitting state), as in Medicare. county is a FIPS code; Medicare's is an SSA code, so crosswalk before comparing. race approximates Medicare race_rti, with Medicaid-only codes 7 and 8 (Medicaid 4 + 7 = Medicare 4). dod is state-reported and less complete than Medicare's. disability_ind is a Medicaid eligibility pathway, not Medicare disability entitlement. Medicare's dual is an annual 0/1 flag; here dual is an annual code and the 0/1 is the monthly dual_ind, under which 09 counts as not dual (MBSF counts it).

name: Daily County-Level Counts
description: Daily County-level Medicaid beneficiary counts by cohort: number of beneficiaries (e.g., n_bene__total, n_bene__ffs, n_bene__disabled) and enrolled months (n_months_enrolled__<cohort>). Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year, excluding restricted-benefit enrollees such as emergency-only, family-planning-only, or Medicare cost-sharing-only). Daily files carry the corresponding monthly/yearly enrollment values for each day.

name: Daily County-Level Denominator Covariates
description: Daily County-level denominator covariates: rates and percentages describing the Medicaid population in each area (e.g., percent female, percent dual-eligible, percent fee-for-service, age and race distributions), by cohort. Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year, excluding restricted-benefit enrollees such as emergency-only, family-planning-only, or Medicare cost-sharing-only). Daily files carry the corresponding monthly/yearly enrollment values for each day.

name: Daily County-Level Stratified Counts
description: Daily County-level Medicaid beneficiary counts by cohort, stratified by age group, sex, race, dual status, managed care, and eligibility group. Daily files carry the corresponding monthly/yearly enrollment values for each day.
